candidates.change_summary: Replace the increment of depositsCount with a decrement, causing depositsCount to decrease on receiving funds.
Replace the increment with no state change by removing the depositsCount update (delete the increment statement).
Replace the require condition with a failing condition that always reverts, preventing depositsCount from changing and reverting all receives.
Replace the require condition with a no-op (remove the require), so depositsCount increments without the original guard.
Insert an extra increment before the existing increment, doubling the increment on each receive.
Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(address(this).balance - 1) so withdrawAll transfers one wei less (possible revert if underflow prevented by compiler).

Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with direct transfer to owner using payable(owner).transfer(address(this).balance), bypassing withdraw and changing observable behavior if withdraw was overridden or had modifier effects.
Remove onlyOwner modifier invocation so withdrawAll becomes callable by anyone, changing when and who can withdraw the balance.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner (invert check) so only non-owner can call withdrawAll, altering observed behavior.
Replace the transfer with a send (bool-return) that does not revert on failure, which can change whether balance is withdrawn after withdraw(...) completes.
Replace the transfer with a low-level call that forwards all gas and does not revert on failure, changing whether funds are actually transferred when withdraw(...) completes.
Make the onlyOwner modifier allow anyone (remove the require), so withdraw can be called by non-owners and thus change observed withdraw behavior.
Change transfer amount to zero, so withdraw(...) will complete but not change contract balance; observable withdraw differs.
